title: Eventual flatness of coefficient subalgebra inclusions
statement: Let k be a field, Λ an Artinian local k-algebra with residue field K, σ:K→Λ a section of reduction, and t a finite subset of Λ whose ideal span is its maximal ideal. Let c be a finite subset of K such that the image of k in Λ lies in the subring generated by t and σ(k(c)). There is a finite subset d of K such that, for every finite s containing both d and c, the inclusion C_s→Λ of [def-weil-pbc-artinian-coefficient-subalgebra] is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No local-ring or finiteness conclusion about C_s is asserted.

proof.text: Let k be a field and Λ an Artinian local k-algebra, K its residue field. Assume a ring section σ:K→Λ, finite maximal-ideal generators t, and finite c⊂K with i(k) in the ring image Ψσ(k(c)[t]). The evaluation Ψσ:K[t]→Λ is surjective: Λ=σ(K)+m and successive substitution of t leaves a remainder in m^r, eventually zero. Its kernel has finitely many polynomial generators by Hilbert basis. Let c0 be the union of c and the finitely many coefficients in those generators. For every finite s⊃c0 put F=k(s), so all relations are defined over F.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FG (lemma-helper, lines 2539-2543: 'Choose sigma and F as in the claim. The kernel of Psi_sigma is generated by finitely many polynomials g_1, ..., g_t in K[x_1, ..., x_d] and we may assume their coefficients are in F after enlarging F'; surjectivity of Psi_sigma, used in 'K[x_1,...,x_d]/(g_1,...,g_t) = Lambda', is written out here)

proof.text: *$A_F\to\Lambda$ is flat.* Let $F\in\mathcal F$ and $B_F=F[x_1,\dots,x_d]/(g_1,\dots,g_t)$, an $F$-algebra. By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-quotient-base-change] (for $F[x]\to K[x]$ and the ideal $(g_1,\dots,g_t)$) and $K\otimes_FF[x]=K[x]$, $B_F\otimes_FK\cong K[x]/(g_1,\dots,g_t)K[x]=K[x]/\ker\Psi_\sigma\cong\Lambda$, and the composite $B_F\to B_F\otimes_FK\cong\Lambda$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$, is the map $\bar\Psi$ induced by $\Psi_\sigma|_{F[x]}$ (which kills the $g_j$). By [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat] (field extension $K/F$, $D=B_F$) $B_F\to B_F\otimes_FK$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], hence injective [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction] (case $I=0$). So $\bar\Psi:B_F\to\Lambda$ is injective with image $A_F$, i.e. $B_F\cong A_F$, and the inclusion $A_F\to\Lambda$, identified with $B_F\to B_F\otimes_FK$, is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

theorem exists_artinian_coefficient_eventual_flatness
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsArtinianRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ]
    (σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ →+* Λ) (t : Finset Λ)
    (c : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))
    (hσ : (IsLocalRing.residue Λ).comp σ = RingHom.id _)
    (ht : Ideal.span (t : Set Λ) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ)
    (hc : ∀ a : k, algebraMap k Λ a ∈ Subring.closure ((t : Set Λ) ∪
      σ '' (IntermediateField.adjoin k (c : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)) :
        Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))) :
    ∃ d : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ),
      ∀ s : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ), d ⊆ s → c ⊆ s →
        RingHom.Flat (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s).val.toRingHom
